verdict.rationale: The open-source fido2-manage tool (with GUI) explicitly supports listing resident credentials/passkeys with user handle and deleting them, per token2-gh-1 and token2-gh-3. However, no evidence shows a explicit credential-capacity indicator (e.g., number of slots used/remaining before the key fills up) — missing for 10: explicit credential slot/capacity reporting, independent hands-on confirmation of capacity behavior.
